name: Ring of Mindless Rage
body:
Aura faint enchantment; CL 5th; Slot ring; Weight –

DESCRIPTION

This ring appears to be a ring of battle frenzy and functions as such. However, any time the wearer suffers damage while using the rage ability, he must make a DC 10 + damage received Will save or begin attacking the closest individual to him, regardless of whether it is friend or foe.

If this occurs, the wearer is unable to end the rage and the effects continue for however many rounds are remaining for the day limit.

This ring can only be removed by the casting of calm emotions and remove curse upon it. Doing so destroys the ring.

CONSTRUCTION REQUIREMENTS

Magic Items ring of battle frenzy

Identification DC 30
False Identification DC 20
